record.question: The pregnant lady said the pain had abated
record.explanation: Answer A: subsided. Abated means became less intense or severe. “Subsided” matches that reduction; “vanished” would require complete disappearance, while increased and escalated express the reverse. Reference: https://assets.cambridge.org/97805215/31054/sample/9780521531054ws.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial; no matching examiner key is asserted.
